carriage_return.wav.rationale: 100 ms RMS/spectrum analysis shows an isolated opening bell/transient at 0.0–0.3 s, predominantly 12090/4820 Hz with decay through 1.1 s; later mechanical activity begins about 1.2 s and continues to about 2.7 s, with dominant body around 310–350 Hz. Continuous interval removes the initial bell without splicing/reordering/speed change, retains lead-in, complete later gesture and recorded decay. This is signal-based editing, not a human audition.
carriage_return.wav.changes: High-pass 45 Hz; two-pole low-pass 6500 Hz; +2 dB broad 330 Hz body EQ; 8/100 ms edge fades; modest transient compression and -1.9 dB output gain. Native recorded room/decay retained; no added synthetic sine, glitch, generated impacts or reverberation.

long_note_one.ogg.changes: Full stereo track; constant -4.28 dB gain derived from measured -19.72 LUFS to target -24 LUFS. Dynamics and original boundaries retained; no trim, fades, compression, time stretching or crossfade. Ogg Vorbis quality 5.
long_note_one.ogg.command: ffmpeg -hide_banner -nostats -y -xerror -i assets/audio/interview/originals/Long_Note_One.mp3 -map 0:a:0 -af volume=-4.28dB -ar 44100 -ac 2 -c:a libvorbis -q:a 5 -map_metadata -1 -metadata 'title=Long note One' -metadata 'artist=Kevin MacLeod' -metadata 'license=CC BY 4.0 https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/' assets/audio/interview/long_note_one.ogg

measurements.method: ffprobe -v error -show_format -show_streams -of json FILE; ffmpeg -hide_banner -nostats -xerror -i FILE -af loudnorm=I=-24:TP=-3:LRA=20:print_format=json,volumedetect -f null - (all four files fully decoded; LUFS/dBTP/LRA are loudnorm input measurements before analysis normalization). SHA-256 computed on exact stored bytes.
measurements.duration_note: Container durations are ffprobe measurements, not rounded source-page claims. Short effect LUFS/LRA are limited by its duration. Vorbis nominal stream bitrate differs from actual container average.

integration.playback: Use WAV at 0 dB player gain as short effect; final peak -5.88 dBTP. Stream music continuously across questions; never set loop unless a later genuine seamless edit is documented. Set background mix gain in scene as needed.
integration.export: Parent must exclude assets/audio/interview/originals/* and provenance.json from Web export; originals are archival source downloads, not runtime resources.
